A. organization analysis

C. task analysis

E. job analysis
F. person analysis
G. program design

        *   Performance analysis (D): Often overlaps with Person Analysis (assessing individual performance to see if training is the solution).

    *   Program Design affects the *creation* of the training course (objectives, content, delivery).
